title: Temporal volume
description: An orbitable volume exposes a moving frame and the history along its edges.
useCase: Compare motion across time without losing the current frame.
reducedMotion: Playback stops; direct orbit and frame selection remain available.
limitations: Thirty-two original procedural frames at 16 fps. Orthographic Canvas 2D projections and edge samples, not a video decoder or volumetric renderer.
look: Near-black stage with an off-white 3D box showing red ellipses and a black bar in front, pixel-history smears on its sides, and an orange scrubber.
motion: Play steps a 32-frame loop at 16 fps on the front face while the sides rebuild from edge-pixel history; dragging or arrow keys orbit the box; a slider scrubs.
adapt: `paintFrame` draws each procedural frame and `render` projects the six faces with `project`, sampling edge pixels into `side` and `top`; `orbit` clamps yaw and pitch, and `tick` advances every `62.5` ms. Replace `paintFrame` and the `frames` canvases with decoded video frames.
